import requests

def client(host=RESTAPI_SERVER_HOST, port=RESTAPI_SERVER_PORT):
    """
    REST-JSON API client
    """
    addr = "http://%s:%d" % (host, port)
    logger.info("Starting REST-JSON API client to '%s'..." % addr)

    # Using requests instead of curl
    logger.info("Making a request to create a new task...")
    response = requests.get(addr + '/task/new')
    if response.status_code == 200:
        taskid = response.json().get('taskid')
        logger.info("Task created with ID: %s" % taskid)
        logger.info("Starting scan...")
        scan_response = requests.post(addr + '/scan/' + taskid + '/start', json={"url": "http://testphp.vulnweb.com/artists.php?artist=1"})
        if scan_response.status_code == 200:
            logger.info("Scan started successfully.")
        else:
            logger.error("Failed to start scan: %s" % scan_response.text)
    else:
        logger.error("Failed to create task: %s" % response.text)
